description: Tasks 10-12: marp-render implementation - generateDeck action with Marp Core + Chromium + JP font, pages stage with browser-based pdf.js rasterization, and proper packaging with assets and pruned node_modules.
steps: TASK 10 - marp-render generateDeck: Completely rewrite lambdas/marp-render/src/index.ts. Remove pdftoppm/libreoffice usage. Implement two actions dispatched by event: (a) action:'generateDeck' - uses @marp-team/marp-core to generate HTML from markdown, then uses puppeteer-core + @sparticuz/chromium to render PDF, PNG per page, and PPTX. Chromium launch follows design doc section 2.2 exactly (chromium.args, chromium.executablePath(), chromium.headless, defaultViewport 1920x1080). Japanese font via base64 @font-face CSS using noto-sans-jp-japanese-400-normal.woff2 loaded from assets/noto-sans-jp.woff2. Include font verification check (measureText comparison). Call document.fonts.ready after setContent. (b) stage:'pages' - PDF rasterization using browser-based pdf.js (task 11).

TASK 11 - marp-render pages stage (pdf.js rasterization): In the 'pages' handler, download PDF from S3, then use Chromium + pdf.js to rasterize each page to 1920x1080 PNG. Use page.evaluate() to run pdf.js inside Chromium browser context. Load pdf.min.mjs and pdf.worker.min.mjs from assets/ directory via Blob URLs. Calculate scale = 1920 / viewport.width (where viewport at scale=1 is typically 1440pt wide for 1920px PDF). Output PNG per page, upload to S3.

TASK 12 - marp-render packaging: (a) Update lambdas/marp-render/package.json: add dependencies @sparticuz/chromium@133.0.0, puppeteer-core@24.2.0, @marp-team/marp-core@4.1.0, pdfjs-dist@4.10.38, @fontsource/noto-sans-jp@5.2.5. (b) Change build script to: esbuild bundle src/index.ts -> dist/index.js with --external:@sparticuz/chromium --external:puppeteer-core --format=cjs --platform=node --target=node22. (c) Add a post-build step that: copies assets (noto-sans-jp.woff2, pdf.min.mjs, pdf.worker.min.mjs) into dist/assets/, copies node_modules/@sparticuz/chromium and node_modules/puppeteer-core (and their deps) into dist/node_modules/, removes @napi-rs (36MB), @fontsource (82MB), pdfjs-dist (35MB), and all *.map files from dist/node_modules/. (d) Update infra/lib/marp-lambda-construct.ts to use Code.fromAsset('../lambdas/marp-render/dist') - it already does this. Ensure the construct has correct memory (3008MB), ephemeral storage (2048MB), timeout (5min).
Run pnpm install && pnpm build && pnpm test
